result:
I’d make high-quality, lifelong education universally accessible—focused not just on facts, but on critical thinking, empathy, media literacy, emotional intelligence, and practical life skills.

Why that one change? Education is a multiplier: it helps people recognize misinformation, make better personal and civic decisions, reduce inequality, improve health, and solve problems creatively. It’s not a cure-all—systems and power still matter—but giving everyone the tools to think clearly and understand each other would make almost every other positive change more possible.
